summary: Eltek Ltd., an Israeli PCB manufacturer, filed a Form 6-K on August 18, 2026, furnishing its second-quarter 2026 press release. The release reports revenues of $11.5 million (down from $12.5 million), an operating loss of $2.5 million, and a net loss of $2.7 million ($0.41 per diluted share), driven by manufacturing stabilization and new ERP and plating line investments. Management comments on transition progress but no special-situation event like a merger, tender offer, or restructuring is disclosed. This is a routine earnings announcement for a foreign private issuer, so it is not classified as a special situation.
